test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The homework is being checked by the teacher."

options.text: The teacher is checking the homework.
The teacher was checking the homework.
The teacher has checked the homework.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, "The homework is being checked by the teacher" is in the passive voice.
 
• To convert this to the active voice: The subject "the teacher" comes first.
 
• The verb "is being checked" changes to "is checking" to match the present continuous tense.
 
• The object "the homework" remains the same at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The teacher is checking the homework."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The teacher was checking the homework." – This is in the past continuous tense, not the present continuous.
 
• **Option 3: **"The teacher checks the homework." – This is in the simple present tense, not the present continuous.
 
• **Option 4: **"The teacher has checked the homework." – This is in the present perfect tense, not the present continuous.
